_doc: Single source of truth for model routing across this harness. Agents declare a role; this file maps role -> concrete model ID. Update model IDs here and regenerate agents with `node scripts/gen-agents.js`.
_note_on_model_field: Values below use Claude Code's family aliases (sonnet/opus/haiku) so this harness auto-tracks the current best version of each family. To pin to a specific version (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6), replace the alias with the explicit ID.

plan.why: Planning is context-heavy but mostly structural; Sonnet handles it without Opus tax.

execute.why: Default for TDD, refactoring, code generation.

think.why: Architectural decisions, multi-system debugging, large-refactor review.

critique.why: Adversarial reviewers (security, harness audits) benefit from Opus's stronger reasoning.

observe.why: Hooks, observers, classifiers, summarizers — cheap and fast.

escalation_rules: Sonnet stuck after one clear retry  -> escalate to Opus
Architectural decision with multi-quarter consequence -> Opus from start
Multi-system bug with no clear entry point -> Opus from start
Hooks, observers, classifiers, log summarization -> Haiku always
